scope: Chat-first Web flow from note, document, resume, URL, screenshot, and bounded public research into one explicitly bound person and relationship context

evidence: A recruiter can start from a note, file, link, or screenshot and explicitly choose an existing person, a new person, or a separate relationship context.
The living person page keeps the source ledger stable while Chat compiles a task-specific view over the selected person and relationship context.
Resume extraction review, public research review, and fact confirmation remain separate decisions; the Chat brief exposes each unresolved layer.
A no-action response is emitted when no reviewed evidence supports a recruiter-owned next move.
Deleting a parent source retracts discovered resources, Wiki blocks, Chat manifests, research tasks, research snapshots, and idempotency responses.

bounded_changes.gap: Public research is executed synchronously and has no recruiter-visible durable task page, cancel control, or resume-after-interruption polling contract.
bounded_changes.recommendation: Add GET and cancel endpoints for research tasks, persist per-page progress, expire abandoned running tasks, and prove tab-close and backend-restart recovery.

bounded_changes.gap: Document and public-page material compiles as source-level proposed context rather than atomic recruiter-confirmable person facts and cross-source conflicts.
bounded_changes.recommendation: Add typed claim proposals with exact spans, temporal validity, field-level confirm or reject, and deterministic conflict grouping before claiming full recruiter-grade compilation.

bounded_changes.gap: The runtime proof is synthetic and does not establish faster recovery or better follow-up outcomes with working recruiters.
bounded_changes.recommendation: Run timed day-in-the-life tests with independent recruiters across interruption, stale evidence, wrong-person, duplicate-file, and no-action cases.

evidence: Name-only evidence is not silently merged; explicit candidate cases, stale-version rejection, defer, bind-existing, and create-new paths have runtime proof.
Every Wiki and Chat block carries source-resource, evidence-fragment, identity, relationship-context, fact-version, or research-snapshot dependencies.
Saving a URL does not authorize crawling. Public research requires an exact HTTPS seed, exact domain, maximum page count, and maximum link depth.

Private and reserved network addresses, cross-domain redirects, oversized pages, and excessive redirects are blocked; the local synthetic DNS gateway remains disabled by default and cannot be enabled in production.
Research results remain proposed evidence with retrieval time and freshness; extraction review does not confirm a claim about the person.
Parent deletion recursively retracts research children and scrubs seed URLs, allowed domains, research authorization scope, snapshots, compiled derivatives, and idempotency responses.

bounded_changes.gap: The crawler has no durable failure sweeper; an abrupt process crash can leave a research task in running state.
bounded_changes.recommendation: Add lease and heartbeat fields, startup reconciliation, bounded retry, and a terminal failed or expired transition with an inspectable audit event.

bounded_changes.gap: Robots handling and HTML extraction are intentionally minimal and have not been validated against a diverse adversarial corpus.
bounded_changes.recommendation: Use a standards-aware robots parser and hardened HTML extraction service with MIME sniffing, decompression limits, redirect-chain logging, and adversarial fixtures.

bounded_changes.gap: Evaluation relies on deterministic synthetic fixtures and one public page rather than a calibrated human gold set and drift monitoring.
bounded_changes.recommendation: Create a versioned, consented gold set for identity, extraction, conflict, freshness, deletion, and prohibited-inference behavior; run order-swap and drift checks.

release_gate.reason: The Web slice closes the governed capture-to-review-to-Chat loop without a safety veto, but production-grade asynchronous research recovery, atomic fact compilation, mobile and extension parity, and field validation remain open.
